title: agent-knowledgebase Plugin Redesign v2.1
domain: python MCP plugin for Claude Code

changes: REWROTE Bug-2 narrative throughout (objectives, components, Phase 0 tasks, MISTAKES.md, success_criteria) per validation finding f-05/f-18/f-21 (INVALID): the previous claim that '@mcp.tool() OUTSIDE @_with_tool_timeout is a NO-OP' was inverted. Empirical verification (tests/test_tool_timeout.py 6/6 passing including test_every_registered_mcp_tool_is_wrapped) confirms the current decorator order WORKS. The actual user-visible Bug-2 is `Settings().resolve_paths()` raising pydantic.ValidationError when AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR is unset (server.py:49-54 + config.py:42-46). Phase 0 fix is now to catch (ValidationError, FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError) in _get_service and emit a structured config_missing payload, plus a one-line bootstrap default to ~/.agent-kb/saves. The decorator-order swap task is REMOVED — performing it would FLIP a working setup into a broken one.

REORDERED phases per finding f-10 (INVALID): Phase 5 (data-migration with read-fallback semantics) now ships BEFORE Phase 4 (default-flip to remote/fastembed). The previous ordering would have silently broken existing v0.6.0 KBs ingested with Ollama qwen3-embedding:8b (4096-dim) the moment the global default flipped to text-embedding-3-small (1536-dim). New ordering: Phase 0 (bug fixes) -> Phase 1 (Pattern A launcher) -> Phase 2 (RetrieverBackend abstraction) -> Phase 3 (MarkdownWikiBackend) -> Phase 4 (Migration tooling + dual-backend transition) -> Phase 5 (Embedding defaults flip) -> Phase 6 (LightRAG, deferred). The risk previously titled 'Partial migration leaves silent half-broken state' is reframed: the read-fallback shipping first is the structural fix; the residual risk is now narrower (per-page provider snapshot for create_embedder_for_model).

REVISED install-size claim per finding f-11 (INVALID): the '~20MB / ~100MB' figure was off by ~35x. chromadb (~400MB) + tree-sitter-languages (~100MB) + onnxruntime-via-fastembed (~150MB) remain even under the redesign. Realistic floor is ~700MB default install (chromadb + tree-sitter + httpx + pydantic + mcp), down from ~2GB. Optional opt-in extras: fastembed-local (+150MB), sentence-transformers (+1.3GB). [project.optional-dependencies] now enumerates: extras['embed-local-st'] = sentence-transformers, extras['embed-local-onnx'] = fastembed, extras['ingest-codebase'] = tree-sitter + tree-sitter-languages, extras['ingest-file'] = pdfplumber, extras['ingest-sql'] = sqlalchemy + sqlparse. chromadb stays in the default install (vector backend).

ADDED explicit AGENT_KB_BACKEND switch ownership per finding f-12 (PARTIAL): new module src/agent_knowledgebase/backends/__init__.py exposes get_backend(settings: Settings) -> RetrieverBackend that reads settings.kb_backend (loads from AGENT_KB_BACKEND env or kb_backend JSON config key, valid values chromadb|markdown|lightrag, default chromadb). Factory dispatches to ChromadbBackend(settings), MarkdownWikiBackend(settings), LightRAGBackend(settings). KnowledgebaseService.__init__ calls get_backend(self._config) once and stores it as self._backend. ALL retrieval code paths route through the backend instance instead of directly through chromadb-specific code. Settings.kb_backend is the new field — disambiguated from the existing Settings.vectorstore (which stays as the chromadb/pinecone vector-store-provider selector for the chromadb backend).

TIGHTENED tool surface enumeration per finding f-07 (VERIFIED but worded awkwardly): replaced the '17+8' phrasing in objectives with the canonical '25 frozen tools' wording. The empirical list from server.py grep at lines 164,180,195,225,265,280,295,313,328,343,364,376,393,416,433,450,482,499,514,532,602,628,695,724,767 is preserved verbatim — no tools added or removed.

overview.description: Redesign of agent-knowledgebase Claude Code plugin (current v0.6.0/0.7.0-WIP) to (1) fix two user-reported bugs in the embedding stack and the kb_* MCP tool surface; (2) remove uv as a hard runtime dependency by replacing the .mcp.json `command:uv,args:[run,...]` invocation with a single cross-platform Python launcher (Pattern A) that auto-bootstraps a stdlib venv; (3) introduce an AGENT_KB_BACKEND={chromadb|markdown|lightrag} feature flag that lets the QueryOrchestrator be swapped without touching the MCP tool contract; (4) preserve in full the v0.6.0 probe-4 contract, the SQL-injection AST validator, the stderr-tee schema, AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR semantics, the cross-process lock recipe, and the 25 frozen kb_* MCP tools. The redesign is gated behind a PRIOR DIAGNOSIS phase (Phase 0) — concrete bug fixes ship first under the existing chromadb backend with NO architecture change, then later phases introduce Pattern A, the RetrieverBackend abstraction, the markdown-wiki backend, dual-backend migration tooling (BEFORE the embedding default-flip), and finally the embedding default change. WIKI-STYLE is reframed as a new opt-in BACKEND OPTION, not a fix for the bugs (per debate synthesis); chromadb stays the default.
objectives: Fix Bug-1: kb_query / kb_search / kb_ingest fail at runtime because (a) Ollama-default embedder reports dimension=0 until first call, never validated against ChromaDB collection's stored dimension, leading to silent dimension-mismatch on first ingest; (b) RemoteEmbedder.dimension hardcodes 1536 fallback regardless of configured model_name (line 248 in embeddings.py).

Fix Bug-2: every kb_* MCP tool fails immediately on a fresh install because `_get_service` (server.py:49-54) calls `Settings().resolve_paths()` which raises pydantic ValidationError when AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR env var is not set (config.py:42-46). The error surfaces as opaque MCP InternalError. The previously-suspected `_with_tool_timeout` decorator NO-OP claim was INCORRECT — `@mcp.tool()` outer + `@_with_tool_timeout` inner is the working order (verified by tests/test_tool_timeout.py 6/6 passing). Fix: catch ValidationError in `_get_service`, emit a structured MCP error suggesting the missing env var, and ship a one-line bootstrap path that defaults `AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR` to `~/.agent-kb/saves` if not configured.

Remove uv as a hard runtime dependency: .mcp.json must launch via `command:python, args:["${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/run_server.py"]` so any system Python>=3.11 on PATH is sufficient. The launcher self-bootstraps a stdlib venv with sentinel-based reuse and a cross-process lock.

Introduce AGENT_KB_BACKEND feature flag — chromadb default; markdown opt-in; lightrag opt-in (deferred). RetrieverBackend protocol is the single swap-point. New module src/agent_knowledgebase/backends/__init__.py owns the factory.

Preserve the v0.6.0 probe-4 contract: 25 frozen tools — kb_create, kb_delete, kb_ingest, kb_ingest_batch, kb_update_source, kb_remove_source, kb_lint, kb_lint_fix, kb_rebuild_index, kb_export, kb_list, kb_info, kb_query, kb_search, kb_get_page, kb_list_pages, kb_get_source, kb_list_sources, kb_get_links, kb_pipeline_status, kb_config_path, kb_config_show, kb_config_get, kb_config_set, kb_config_validate — tool names, parameter names, response shapes ALL frozen.

Default install size drops from ~2GB to ~700MB (default: chromadb + tree-sitter + httpx + pydantic + mcp). Heavy ML deps move to opt-in extras: extras['embed-local-st'] (sentence-transformers, +1.3GB), extras['embed-local-onnx'] (fastembed, +150MB), extras['ingest-codebase'] (tree-sitter explicitly required only for codebase ingestor), extras['ingest-file'] (pdfplumber), extras['ingest-sql'] (sqlalchemy + sqlparse). Numbers floor on chromadb (~400MB) + tree-sitter-languages (~100MB) which are required for the default vector + codebase paths and cannot be removed without breaking those paths.
constraints: HARD NON-GOAL: redesign must NOT regress probe-4 contract enforced by data-etl-orchestrator >= v0.4.0.

HARD NON-GOAL: SQL-injection AST validator (where_clause_validator + read-only sqlite ?mode=ro + 50-row hard-reject) is frozen — any change to ingestors/sql_database* requires test_where_clause_validator.py + test_sql_database_ingest.py green.
HARD NON-GOAL: knowledgebase_stderr_log JSON schema (11 fields) is frozen across all backends. Pinned by contract test.
HARD NON-GOAL: AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR semantics, cross-process-lock recipe (filelock-based per-kb_id locking), and pipeline_runs telemetry columns from v0.6.0 carry forward unchanged across all backends.
HARD NON-GOAL: kb_* MCP tool names + minimum response shape (source_type, uri, dedup_key, page_id, dominant_embedding_model) are frozen by probe-4. Backend swap preserves them at MCP boundary.

Forbid partial migration: if sentence-transformers removed from default, codebase/directory/git_history ingestors must either (a) ship remote-embedding fallback FIRST or (b) emit KB_INGESTOR_UNAVAILABLE structured error. No silent half-broken state.

Pattern A launcher MUST distinguish 3 failure modes with structured stderr — python-not-found, network-unreachable (PyPI 30s timeout), read-only-filesystem — and provide AGENT_KB_VENDORED_DEPS=/path/to/wheels offline escape-hatch.
Backwards compatibility: kb_info on v0.6.0-ingested KB must return all fields probe-4 inspects, regardless of new backend (contract test pins this).
Phase ordering invariant: data-migration tooling with read-fallback (Phase 4) MUST ship before the embedding-default flip (Phase 5). Reversing this order silently breaks existing v0.6.0 KBs.
assumptions: Target users have a system Python>=3.11 on PATH; if not, structured stderr instructs them to install Python (the launcher's only hard prerequisite).

Ollama running on http://127.0.0.1:11434 is a common-enough development setup that it remains a valid default base_url for the 'ollama' provider, but the default provider after redesign is 'remote' targeting an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
ChromaDB collection-per-kb-id pattern (one collection per knowledgebase, name = kb_id) is preserved exactly as in v0.6.0 vectorstore.py.
Existing v0.6.0 chromadb-indexed KBs must continue to query AS-IS during the dual-backend transition window (read-fallback semantics shipped in Phase 4 BEFORE Phase 5 default-flip).
fastembed and onnxruntime ABI compatibility on Windows ARM and macOS-arm64 is acceptable but not load-bearing — fastembed is opt-in only.

Multi-vector-per-object (title + body + summary vectors) is documented as a forward-compatible shape but NOT implemented in this redesign — chromadb cannot host it natively (debate domain-specialist), and parallel-collection orchestration is out of scope.

components.name: bin/run_server.py — Pattern A single Python launcher
components.responsibility: Cross-platform venv auto-bootstrap and server invocation. Replaces .mcp.json's `command:uv,args:[run,...]`. Invoked as `command:python, args:[${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/run_server.py]`. (1) Locate or create ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv via stdlib `venv` module (handles Scripts/ on Windows, bin/ on Unix). (2) Acquire ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv.lock via filelock to make first-run pip install crash-safe under concurrent Claude Code worker spawns. (3) Compute SHA256(requirements.lock) and compare against ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv/.req-sha — if mismatch, run `pip install -r requirements.lock` (or AGENT_KB_VENDORED_DEPS path) inside venv, write new sentinel; if match, skip. (4) Verify Python>=3.11 fail-fast with structured stderr. (5) Three structured stderr error modes: {error:'python_version', detail:'<3.11'} ; {error:'network_unreachable', detail:'PyPI 30s timeout — set AGENT_KB_VENDORED_DEPS'} ; {error:'read_only_filesystem', detail:'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT not writable'}. (6) os.execv venv-python `-m agent_knowledgebase.server`. Single file — NO bash/cmd companion.
dependencies: Python>=3.11 stdlib only (venv, filelock via stdlib fcntl/msvcrt fallback, hashlib, subprocess, json, sys)

components.name: AGENT_KB_BACKEND feature flag + RetrieverBackend protocol + backend factory
components.responsibility: New module src/agent_knowledgebase/backends/__init__.py exposes `def get_backend(settings: Settings) -> RetrieverBackend`. The factory reads `settings.kb_backend` (which loads from AGENT_KB_BACKEND env var via pydantic-settings or from the kb_backend key in the JSON config — valid values: chromadb|markdown|lightrag, default chromadb). The factory dispatches to ChromadbBackend(settings), MarkdownWikiBackend(settings), or LightRAGBackend(settings). New env var AGENT_KB_BACKEND={chromadb|markdown|lightrag}. Promotes existing QueryOrchestrator into a strict abstraction: `class RetrieverBackend(Protocol)` with methods `add(...) -> None`, `query(text, top_k, filters) -> list[QueryResult]`, `search(text, top_k, filters) -> list[QueryResult]`, `delete(ids) -> None`, `count() -> int`, `health_check() -> dict`. ChromadbBackend = current behavior wrapped (no behavior change). MarkdownWikiBackend reads filesystem directly (no embedding). LightRAGBackend forwards to localhost:9621 REST API. KnowledgebaseService.__init__ calls get_backend(self._config) ONCE at construction time and stores the result as self._backend. ALL retrieval code paths now route through self._backend instead of directly through chromadb-specific code. Disambiguates from existing Settings.vectorstore (which stays as the per-backend vector-store-provider choice — chromadb backend uses settings.vectorstore in {chromadb, pinecone}).

components.name: Embedding layer — remote-only default, fastembed optional, sentence-transformers retained
components.responsibility: Refactor src/agent_knowledgebase/services/embeddings.py. (1) Default embedding_provider switches to 'remote' targeting OpenAI-compatible /embeddings (Ollama's /v1 surface or hosted API). embedding_model default becomes 'text-embedding-3-small' to match RemoteEmbedder._REMOTE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS table. (2) Add 'fastembed' provider — uses qdrant-fastembed library with ONNX MiniLM. Opt-in via extras['embed-local-onnx'] (~150MB install delta). (3) sentence-transformers retained as backwards-compat (BC) for v0.6.0 KBs but no longer in default install — opt-in via extras['embed-local-st'] (~1.3GB install delta). (4) Stamp embedder_version (not just model_name) on every chunk ingest — fastembed-MiniLM-int8 != HF-MiniLM-fp32 even though both are 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2'. Add Chunk.embedder_version column. (5) Probe embedding dimension via single-text dry-run on first use, persist to KB metadata; reject ingest/query if dimension mismatches stored. (6) Stamp (embedding_provider, embed_base_url) alongside dominant_embedding_model on every page so create_embedder_for_model can faithfully rebuild the original embedder for read-fallback at query time.
dependencies: Migration: ALTER TABLE chunks ADD COLUMN embedder_version TEXT

Empirically verified at server.py decorator hits lines 164,180,195,225,265,280,295,313,328,343,364,376,393,416,433,450,482,499,514,532,602,628,695,724,767. Tool dispatcher in KnowledgebaseService routes through RetrieverBackend selected by Settings.kb_backend.

tests/test_tool_timeout.py (currently 6/6 passing including test_every_registered_mcp_tool_is_wrapped — pinned, do not regress)

components.name: _get_service config-error wrapping — Bug-2 actual fix
components.responsibility: Bug-2 actual root cause: server.py:49-54 _get_service() calls `Settings().resolve_paths()` without error handling. When AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR is unset, pydantic.ValidationError raises (config.py:42-46 declares saves_dir Field with no default). When AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR is set to a non-existent path, FileNotFoundError raises (config.py:217-220). Either propagates as opaque MCP InternalError on every kb_* call. Fix: (a) wrap _get_service body in `try: ... except (pydantic.ValidationError, FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError) as exc: ...` and emit a structured ServiceUnavailableError carrying {error:'config_missing', missing:'AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR', detail:'...'} that each kb_* tool dispatcher serializes to its JSON return; (b) ship a one-line bootstrap path that defaults AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR to ~/.agent-kb/saves if not configured (so a fresh install works without any env var); (c) add a server startup precheck in main() so missing config fails immediately with structured stderr instead of on the first MCP call. Note: the timeout-decorator-NO-OP narrative from the prior spec draft was INCORRECT — `@mcp.tool()` OUTER + `@_with_tool_timeout` INNER is the working order (verified empirically by tests/test_tool_timeout.py 6/6 passing). DO NOT swap.
dependencies: config.py — optional: add saves_dir default factory to Path.home() / '.agent-kb' / 'saves'

components.name: Migration tooling — dual-backend transition window
components.responsibility: src/agent_knowledgebase/services/migration.py (new). (a) export_kb(kb_id, format='markdown_wiki'|'chromadb_dump') CLI subcommand. (b) import_kb(kb_id, source_path) CLI subcommand. (c) Dual-backend read-fallback at query time: if Settings.kb_backend='markdown' but a KB still has chromadb collection (vector_store/ exists, wiki/ does not), ChromadbBackend serves the query — silent fallback, structured stderr line emitted. (d) kb_migrate(kb_id, target_backend) MCP tool (NEW — additive, non-breaking; not required by probe-4). (e) Hard-cutover criterion: migration_complete sentinel file under saves_dir/<kb-name>/.migrated_to=<backend>. (f) AGENT_KB_BACKEND_PER_KB env override format: kb_id=backend, comma-separated. (g) Per-page (embedding_provider, embed_base_url) snapshot read at query time so create_embedder_for_model rebuilds the original embedder even after the global default flips in Phase 5.
dependencies: Both source and target backends must coexist for the transition window (Phase 4)
Per-page provider snapshot (Phase 4 prerequisite for Phase 5)

components.name: MarkdownWikiBackend — Karpathy-style backend
components.responsibility: src/agent_knowledgebase/backends/markdown_backend.py. Layout under saves_dir/<kb-name>/wiki/: index.md (LLM-maintained), hot.md (~500-char hot cache), log.md (op history), pages/<slug>.md per article. Ingest flow: kb_ingest writes raw source under raw/, schedules an LLM-driven page-extraction (out-of-band — NOT during MCP RPC). Query flow: backend reads index.md, returns top-K candidate page IDs based on FTS over pages/*.md (sqlite FTS5 in-memory). NO embedding. Sharded index.md when article-count crosses 200-300 (per debate domain-specialist break-even). Per-source_type guard: backend.add() uses a positive-allow list — ALLOW {file, website, api_endpoint with payload <2MB}; everything else (sql_database, codebase, git_history, directory, large api_endpoint) raises KB_INGESTOR_UNSUITABLE unless AGENT_KB_FORCE_WIKI_INGEST=1 (debate per-source_type cost model: hours of LLM cost at 1000+ rows).
dependencies: trafilatura (already in deps for source extraction)

components.name: Documentation — alternate runtime patterns
components.responsibility: README updates: Pattern A is default (.mcp.json ships ready-to-use); Pattern C (pipx install agent-knowledgebase-claude-plugin) documented as alternate WITH explicit caveat that Claude Code plugin marketplace does NOT auto-run pipx install — user step required; Pattern D (Docker GHCR image) documented as zero-Python-on-host alternate. PEP-723 noted as future-only path. docs/install_size.md tables: default ~700MB; +extras['embed-local-onnx'] = +150MB; +extras['embed-local-st'] = +1.3GB; +extras['ingest-codebase'] (always-on for default install since chromadb+tree-sitter required) = baseline; clearly documents what users save by NOT installing each extra.

architecture.data_flow: MCP request -> server.py @_with_tool_timeout-wrapped tool (current decorator order PRESERVED, do not swap) -> KnowledgebaseService -> self._backend (RetrieverBackend instance, selected once at __init__ via get_backend(settings)) -> {ChromadbBackend -> embedder.embed_query -> chromadb collection} OR {MarkdownWikiBackend -> sqlite FTS5 over pages/*.md} OR {LightRAGBackend -> HTTP localhost:9621 -> REST endpoint}. Response -> JSON serialization (preserved v0.6.0 shape) -> MCP. Telemetry: every call writes one line to knowledgebase_stderr_log (11 fields, frozen schema). pipeline_runs row written for kb_ingest / kb_ingest_batch / kb_update_source. Cross-process lock acquired per-kb_id for any write path (ingest, update, remove). Bug-2 surface: _get_service() now catches (ValidationError, FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError) and returns structured config_missing payload instead of opaque MCP InternalError.
integration_points: data-etl-orchestrator probe-4 — frozen contract; agent-knowledgebase >= 0.6.0 floor unchanged. Probe inspects kb_info response fields (source_type, uri, dedup_key, page_id, dominant_embedding_model) — backend swap MUST preserve.
consumer-side stderr-capture discipline — knowledgebase_stderr_log 11-field schema preserved across backends. Contract test: tests/contract/test_stderr_schema.py.

AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR — required env var unchanged in semantics; backend selects storage shape under <saves_dir>/<sanitized-name>/{vector_store/ for chromadb, wiki/ for markdown}. Bug-2 fix adds graceful fallback to ~/.agent-kb/saves when unset.
Cross-process file lock — preserved per-kb_id (filelock under <saves_dir>/<sanitized-name>/.lock).
AGENT_KB_BACKEND new env var — chromadb (default) | markdown | lightrag. Loaded via pydantic-settings into Settings.kb_backend.
AGENT_KB_BACKEND_PER_KB new env var — per-kb override format (kb_id1=markdown,kb_id2=chromadb).
AGENT_KB_VENDORED_DEPS new env var — offline escape-hatch path to wheels for air-gapped install.
AGENT_KB_FORCE_WIKI_INGEST new env var — bypass per-source_type allow-list on markdown backend.
Settings.kb_backend new pydantic field — disambiguated from existing Settings.vectorstore (which remains the chromadb/pinecone vector-store-provider choice within the chromadb backend).

phases.description: SHIP FIRST. Fix the two stated bugs under the existing chromadb backend with zero architectural change. Establishes that the redesign is additive, not replacement-driven. PR small, reviewable, test-anchored. Per debate: 'concrete bug-diagnosis phase BEFORE the redesign decision' is a HARD prerequisite. CRITICAL: do NOT swap decorator order on @mcp.tool() / @_with_tool_timeout — the current order works (verified by tests/test_tool_timeout.py 6/6 passing).
tasks: Fix Bug-2 in server.py:49-54 — wrap _get_service body in try/except for (pydantic.ValidationError, FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError); on catch, return a sentinel structured-error service object whose tool methods all return JSON {error:'config_missing', missing:'AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR', detail:'set AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR env var to a writable directory'}.

Add a one-line bootstrap default in config.py: saves_dir Field default_factory = lambda: Path.home() / '.agent-kb' / 'saves' (only used when AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR env is unset and no JSON config provides it). This makes a fresh install work without any env var.

Add main() startup precheck in server.py: call Settings().resolve_paths() once at startup; if it raises, emit structured stderr and exit non-zero so users see config errors immediately instead of on first MCP call.

Add tests/contract/test_decorator_order.py: assert mcp._tool_manager._tools[name].fn has __wrapped__ attribute pointing to a callable, for every registered tool. Document explicitly that this is a regression guard against accidental future inversion — NOT proof of any current bug. Reference test_tool_timeout.py::test_every_registered_mcp_tool_is_wrapped which already passes 6/6 today.

Add tests/test_get_service_config_missing.py: monkey-patch os.environ to remove AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR; call kb_list (or any kb_* tool) via FastMCP; assert response is JSON {error:'config_missing', missing:'AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR'} not a raw exception.

Fix Bug-1 dimension validation in embeddings.py: (a) add `probe_dimension(self) -> int` method to Embedder protocol that issues a single dry-run embed of 'probe' and returns len(vector); (b) RemoteEmbedder uses probe_dimension if model_name not in _REMOTE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS instead of hardcoding 1536; (c) OllamaEmbedder calls probe_dimension on first __init__ if dimension_cache is None and the caller asked for .dimension; (d) ChromaDBStore.__init__ accepts expected_dim and asserts collection.metadata['dim'] matches OR sets it on creation.
Add tests/test_embedder_dimension_probe.py: mock httpx response, assert RemoteEmbedder('qwen3-embedding:8b').dimension probes via embed call (does NOT return 1536 fallback).

Add tests/test_chromadb_dimension_mismatch.py: ingest with embedder A (dim=384), then attempt query with embedder B (dim=1536) — service must raise EmbedderDimensionMismatchError, not silently mismatch.
Add explicit HTTP-status classification (404 model-not-pulled, 401/403 auth, 429 rate-limited) to EmbedderUnavailableError beyond just timeout/network errors per validation finding f-03.
Run full pytest suite + ruff + (optionally) mypy. Pre-existing lint/type errors flagged in CLAUDE.md must be fixed or explicitly listed.
Bump pyproject.toml version 0.7.0 -> 0.7.1, append CHANGELOG entry pinning the two bug fixes.
deliverables: PR: 'fix(kb): wrap _get_service config errors + dimension probing'

MISTAKES.md entry: 'Decorator order at @mcp.tool() boundary — @mcp.tool() should be the OUTER decorator so FastMCP registers the wrapped function. @_with_tool_timeout goes INNER. risks.description: Pattern A launcher fails on Windows stdio launch. Claude Code passes the command directly to OS process spawner; if the shebang or PATHEXT resolution misbehaves, the launcher hangs at start without producing diagnostics.

notes:
REVISION v2.1 NOTES:

This spec supersedes v2.0. The five high-severity validation findings (f-05, f-10, f-11, f-12, f-18, f-21) have all been propagated through objectives/components/phases/risks/success_criteria. Most surprising correction: the entire Bug-2 'decorator NO-OP' narrative in v2.0 was inverted. tests/test_tool_timeout.py has been passing 6/6 the whole time including test_every_registered_mcp_tool_is_wrapped — proving the current decorator order works. The actual user-visible bug is the unwrapped pydantic.ValidationError in _get_service when AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR is unset. v2.0's Phase 0 task list would have FLIPPED a working setup into a broken one. v2.1 removes that swap and replaces it with an exception-wrap fix.

OPEN QUESTIONS (carry-forward from debate, unresolved):

1. Concrete bug diagnosis precedes architectural commitment. RESOLVED in Phase 0 — root causes pinned: Bug-1 = embeddings.py:248 RemoteEmbedder.dimension hardcodes 1536 + OllamaEmbedder.dimension returns 0 until probe (line 350); Bug-2 = server.py:49-54 _get_service unwrapped Settings().resolve_paths() raises pydantic.ValidationError on missing AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR. Phase 0 fix-PR ships these directly under chromadb backend with NO architecture change.

2. If multi-vector retained, do we accept Weaviate/Qdrant migration or parallel chromadb collections? OPEN — deferred. Current spec documents multi-vector as forward-compatible shape only; no implementation in v0.8.x.

3. How do v0.6.0 invariants carry into wiki backend? PARTIALLY RESOLVED in spec — probe-4 fields preserved as null where N/A; SQL-injection validator stays in ingestors/ unchanged; stderr schema enforced by contract test; cross-process lock acquired identically. STILL OPEN: per-page embedding model field on markdown wiki — convention is to return null (markdown does not embed); probe-4 must accept null. Coordination issue against data-etl-orchestrator filed in Phase 2.

4. Validation experiment for wiki retrieval quality. OPEN — Phase 3 ships markdown backend opt-in, but no controlled benchmark on user actual corpora. Recommendation: add Phase 7 validation experiment with side-by-side chromadb vs markdown queries on a curated test KB.

5. embedder_version + dimension + quantization compatibility matrix. PARTIALLY RESOLVED — Phase 5 stamps embedder_version per chunk; reject mixed embedder_version on same kb_id at ingest unless AGENT_KB_AUTO_REEMBED=1. Compatibility matrix lives in docs/embedder_compat.md (Phase 5 deliverable extension).

DEBATE-REJECTED CHANGES (considered, rejected with rationale):
- 'Delete WIKI-STYLE entirely' — REJECTED: Karpathy source at relevance 1.0 is real evidence; demote to opt-in backend with per-source_type allow-list, not delete.
- 'Drop chromadb/sentence-transformers immediately' — REJECTED: three ingestors silently depend on these; SQL-injection validator binds to current schema. sentence-transformers moves to extras; chromadb stays default.
- 'Adopt fastembed as drop-in for sentence-transformers' — REJECTED: int8/fp32 delta material at MMR boundary; framing as drop-in would silently break retrieval quality. Jaccard@10 parity test added.
- 'Promote multi-vector as low-complexity win on chromadb' — REJECTED: chromadb lacks native named-vectors; requires parallel collections or vector-store migration.
- 'Swap @mcp.tool() / @_with_tool_timeout decorator order' — REJECTED in v2.1: empirically the current order works (test_tool_timeout.py 6/6 passing). Swapping would break a working setup.

KNOWN BUGS (file:line citations from diagnosis grep, REVISED v2.1):
- Bug-1a: src/agent_knowledgebase/services/embeddings.py:248 — RemoteEmbedder.dimension returns hardcoded 1536 for unknown model_name (e.g. 'qwen3-embedding:8b' which is 4096-dim). Silent ChromaDB dimension mismatch on first ingest.
- Bug-1b: src/agent_knowledgebase/services/embeddings.py:350 — OllamaEmbedder.dimension returns 0 (cache empty) until first embed call.
- Bug-1c: src/agent_knowledgebase/services/embeddings.py:215-228 — _call_embed catches BaseException, classifies only httpx transport errors, raises EmbedderUnavailableError. HTTP 4xx/5xx (e.g. model-not-pulled 404 from Ollama) propagate raw without context. Phase 0 adds explicit HTTP-status classification.
- Bug-1d: src/agent_knowledgebase/services/embeddings.py:424-430 — RemoteEmbedder factory raises ValueError if api_key/base_url missing; this is correct but the error happens inside KnowledgebaseService construction, surfacing as 'Internal Server Error' to MCP caller. Phase 0 _get_service wrap fixes this.
- Bug-2 (REVISED ROOT CAUSE, v2.1): src/agent_knowledgebase/server.py:49-54 — _get_service() calls Settings().resolve_paths() without exception handling. config.py:42-46 declares saves_dir Field with no default; pydantic.ValidationError raises when AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR is unset. config.py:217-220 raises FileNotFoundError when AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR points to a non-existent path. Either propagates as opaque MCP InternalError on every kb_* call. Empirically verified: `del os.environ['AGENT_KB_SAVES_DIR']; Settings()` raises ValidationError 'saves_dir Field required'.

The v2.0 'decorator NO-OP' diagnosis was an artifact of confused reasoning in the original notes-section. The spec.notes self-correction in v2.0 ('REVISED Bug-2 root cause') was correct but failed to propagate into the body. v2.1 propagates fully.

FINAL Bug-2 fix list (v2.1):
- server.py:49-54 _get_service() — catch (pydantic.ValidationError, FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError); return structured config_missing payload.
- config.py saves_dir Field — add default_factory pointing to Path.home() / '.agent-kb' / 'saves' so a fresh install works without any env var.
- server.py main() — add startup precheck so missing config fails immediately with structured stderr.
- Add tests/test_get_service_config_missing.py (new) and tests/contract/test_decorator_order.py (regression guard, NOT a bug fix).
- DO NOT swap @mcp.tool() / @_with_tool_timeout decorator order — current order is verified working.

This spec ships Phase 0 first to prove out the bug fixes, then Phases 1-5 in REVISED order (migration tooling Phase 4 PRECEDES embedding default-flip Phase 5). Phase 6 (LightRAG) is conditional on adoption signal.
